libvirtd_config_file.description: Path to this configuration file (usually auto-detected).

log_file.description: Path to the libvirtd log file.

auth_unix_ro.description: List of authentication methods for read-only Unix socket access (max 2).

auth_unix_rw.description: List of authentication methods for read-write Unix socket access (max 2).

unix_sock_ro_perms.description: Octal permission mask for read-only Unix socket.

unix_sock_rw_perms.description: Octal permission mask for read-write Unix socket.

listen_tcp.description: Enable TCP listener for remote connections (insecure without TLS).

listen_tls.description: Enable TLS-encrypted TCP listener for secure remote connections.

tcp_port.description: TCP port for non-TLS libvirtd connections.

tls_port.description: TCP port for TLS-secured libvirtd connections.

listen_addr.description: IP address libvirtd binds to for TCP/TLS listeners.

tls_cert_directory.description: Base directory containing TLS certificates and keys.

tls_allowed_cn_list.description: List of allowed Common Names (CNs) in client certificates (empty = allow all).

max_workers.description: Maximum number of worker threads in the pool.

min_workers.description: Minimum number of worker threads kept ready.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

max_requests.description: Maximum number of requests per client connection.

client_idle_timeout.description: Seconds before idle client connections are closed (0 = disabled).

network_start.description: Whether to auto-start the default virtual network (libvirt-default).

default_uri.description: Default hypervisor URI for local clients (e.g., virsh).

auto_start_storage_pools.description: List of storage pool names to auto-start at libvirtd startup.

qemu_user.description: User account under which QEMU processes run.

qemu_group.description: Group ownership for QEMU processes and disks.

qemu_dynamic_ownership.description: Whether libvirt should chown disk images for QEMU access.

qemu_image_configuration.description: Per-image storage configuration overrides (applied to all images by default).

cache.description: Cache mode for I/O (none, writeback, etc.).
